fact: Under Presidential Decree 176/24 of 24 July 2024, from October 2024 requests for municipal services must be registered in and paid through the Portal do Munícipe (payment via RUPE), a portal the Icolo e Bengo administrator says has run since 2018 with real-time control of receipts, though poor internet still limits it.
title: Actos administrativos e serviços municipais passam a ser pedidos no Portal do Munícipe
